"When this hits a hero, you may turn a card in THEIR ARSENAL FACE UP, then destroy a defense reaction in their arsenal." The flip was REVEAL_TOP_DECK -- the top of a DECK, not a card in an arsenal, and a different zone entirely -- and its 'target' was unread, so it revealed the CONTROLLER's own deck. It was also mandatory where the card says "you may"; the flip is what makes the destroy possible, so being forced to reveal is a real difference. The type is DefenseReaction (no space): "Defense Reaction" matches nothing.

"Defense reactions can't be played to this chain link" is NOT implemented: defence reactions are played in the reaction step, which has no restriction hook, and the defend step already excludes them (CR 7.3.2a). It had been RESTRICT_DEFENSE_TO_HEAD_EQUIPMENT, which restricts ORDINARY defenders -- a real and wrong restriction in place of a missing one.
